identity.corePattern: One sentence capturing how this person decides. Not what they do, but HOW they think.
mentalization.goals: Context-specific goals. Different contexts = different priorities. This shows what matters to them in each situation.
mentalization.behaviors: Observable actions triggered by specific contexts. Not personality traits, but patterns you can actually see.
mentalization.frictionPoints: Where they break. Why they break. This is where design fails for this persona.
mentalization.tensions: The competing needs they live in. How do they resolve them? This shows their value hierarchy.
mentalization.contextualVariations: Same person, different conditions = different patterns. Shows they're complex, not one-dimensional.
scenarios: Concrete situations showing why this persona matters. Not abstract, but real.
terminology: Domain vocab they use. If you don't speak their language, you can't mentalize with them.
evidence: Where does this come from? What would prove it wrong? Makes the persona auditable, not guesswork.
